1.description: [Alar] Crusader Strike no longer has a PvP mod. It previously dealt 20% reduced damage versus players. (This includes One with the Light.)
Divine Storm now deals 10% reduced damage to players, changed from 20%. (This includes One with the Light.)
Eviscerate no longer has a PvP mod. It previously dealt 5% reduced damage versus players.
[Alar] Sinister Strike now deals 5% reduced damage versus players, changed from 15%.
[Area 52] Corrected an issue where Sinister Strike was dealing 15% reduced damage versus players, instead of the correct 5%.
Shockwave now deals 15% reduced damage in 2v2 and 3v3 arenas.
Bloodlust is now usable while shapeshifted.
Redirect now has a 15 sec cooldown, changed from 20.
Roar of Sacrifice now lasts for 12 sec, changed from 8 sec.

Juggernaut is now a 2 point talent, changed from a 3 point talent. It no longer reduces the cooldown of Charge. (Being able to reduce Charge to 13 sec cooldown was too powerful and frustrating to play against.)
Furious Attacks can now be learned at level 25, changed from level 45. (To better be able to combat strong healing in earlier levels.)
Unrelenting Assault now reduces magical damage and healing by 8/15%, changed from 10/20%.
You now heal for 5% less while your Primary Stat is Spirit in Battlegrounds and Arenas.
All single target spells with a cast time or channel time now deals 5% increased damage in 2v2 and 3v3 arena.
Aimed Shot now reduces healing taken by 30%, changed from 35%.
asd/changelog create realm:Live label:Fix publish:False description: Mortal Strike now reduces healing taken by 30%, changed from 35%.
Temporarily reverted the changes putting Poisons on the melee table as they were causing performance issues. A fix for this is underway and will be pushed as soon as possible.

7.description: Controlled Burn has had a slight rework and now reads: Your Chaos Bolt increases the duration of your Immolate by 6 seconds and causes your next Conflagrate to not consume Immolate. In addition, your Scorch on Conflagrated targets deal additional damage. (This change aims to make the playstyle more active and to increase the difficulty to not consume Immolate in PvP while having minimal impact in PvE.)

0.description: [Alar] Resilient Constitution now reduces damage taken in PvP by 53%, changed from 50%.
Black Widow Strike now increases the effectiveness of your Hunter Abilities by 10% from 8%.
Significantly Increased the Base Damage of the Black Widow Poison (DoT) from the Black Widow Strike Mystic Enchantment.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where the damage from Devil's Claw on Lucifur was not having its AP & SP coefficients applied correctly.
Increased Battleground Experience per kill on Alar by 20%.
[Pending Restart] - Thunder Clap and Shockwave will no longer be able to be blocked.

Escape from Durnholde - Riflemen will no longer scatter shot the tank. This mechanic would cause the tank to immediately lose control of their character and all aggressive mobs would turn and instantly kill the closest target.

Shattered Halls - Sharpshooters will no longer scatter shot the tank. This mechanic would cause the tank to immediately lose control of their character and all aggressive mobs would turn and instantly kill the closest target.

7.description: [Pending restart] [Pending patch] The Divine Providence mystic enchant now also increases the healing of Penance, just like its talent counterpart.

8.description: [Pending Restart] - "Conqeurors Wanted: " is a new callboard quest for delving and taking down mythic dungeon bosses, akin to the Heroic and Normal dungeon dailies.

7.description: [Pending restart] Fixed an issue where Fleeting Shadows could trigger more than intended. It will now only trigger when in Stealth.

0.description: [Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Deadly Poison would not apply your other poison (usually instant) upon reaching 5 stacks of Deadly Poison.
Fixed a short-long-lived bug that could cause blade flurry to sometimes fail to trigger.
[Pending Restart] - Mythic0 achievements are now available for TBC Dungeons.

1.description: Temporarily reverted the change made to Deadly Poison being moved to melee hit and critical strike chance as we resolve an issue with this change.
Fixed an issue which could cause Gouge to not break on damage taken.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where some players had an aura from an unused talent rank, causing their Howl of Terror to have shorter cast time.
[Pending restart] Hunters Mark now breaks Stealth when used.
[Pending restart] Manaforged Barrier now reduces your damage and healing done by 40%, from 50%.
[Pending restart] Instant Poison now deals 35% reduced damage against players, changed from 25%.
[Pending restart] Deadly Poison now deals 40% reduced damage against players, changed from 30%.

[Pending restart] The Improved Poisons capstone effect has been replaced now that Poisons no longer are on the spell hit table. The new capstone effect allows the periodic damage of your Deadly Poison to critically hit.

[Pending restart] Reduced the attack power coefficient of poisons by 8%. This is meant to partially offset the damage increase from poisons being considered melee spells, which results in a 10-20% damage increase (depending on your crit and hit chance).

[Pending restart] Rogue Poisons are now considered melee attacks rather than spells, meaning their chance to hit and crit mirrors that of melee attacks and their critical strikes deal 200% normal damage, up from 150%. This will make Poison behavior more consistent with similar effects and more intuitive.
[Pending restart] Increased the spell damage coefficient of Starfire from 0.42 to 0.46.
[Pending restart] Increased the spell damage coefficient of Wrath from 0.384 to 0.42.
[Pending restart] Increased the healing power coefficient of the periodic effect of Lifebloom from 0.0276 to 0.033.
[Pending restart] Increased the spell damage coefficient of Frostbolt from 0.55 to 0.58.
[Pending restart] Divine Providence now also increases the healing of Penance by 3/6/9%.
[Pending restart] Increased the healing of Penance by 8%.

8.description: Changed No Risk and High Risk variants of the Keeping Evil at Bay: Eclipsion Fields quest to require 6 Crazed Colossus slain instead of 10.
[Pending Restart] Path to Ascension: PvP power now requires you to have 250 PvP power, changed from 350.
[Pending Restart] - Akin to the Threat to Azeroth Quests in Classic, TBC will now also have World Boss Weekly quests that offer 2,500 Marks of Ascension for taking down a world boss.

7.description: [Pending restart] Freezing Strike now has a 6 second ICD, preventing it from being far too strong when used with Wind Strike.
[Pending restart] Reduced the damage bonus granted by Knight of the Eclipse to Wrath and Starfire to 45% per stack, from 50%, to offset the baseline buffs to Wrath and Starfire.
[Pending restart] The healing done by Adorned from the Champion of Justice legendary enchant has been reduced by 10%.
[Pending restart] The penalty to your Healing Touch coefficient on Urgent Touch has been reduced from 15% to 10%.

[Pending restart] The spell damage coefficient of Fire Watch has been reduced from 0.29 to 0.24. Its attack power coefficient remains unchanged. It now deals 10% reduced damage versus players, from 15%.

[Pending restart] Prophet of Wrath now increases your critical strike damage bonus by 50% while Divine Illumination. The old tooltip said that critical strike damage was increased by 20%, which was inaccurate. This change will reduce the critical strike damage of Prophet of Wrath by about 4%, bringing them more in line with other builds.
[Pending restart] The spell damage coefficient of Twilight Torment has been reduced from 0.75 to 0.70. It now deals 25% reduced damage versus players, changed from 30%.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the root from Total Eclipse could break instantly.
Fixed an issue where Fleeting Shadow didnt work.
